notes:
**A new Settings screen.** Settings are now grouped into sections (Page turning, Pen and edit mode, Sidebar tools, Tablet and stylus, Troubleshooting), with bigger controls and clear Off/On choices. Sidebar tools are tiles you tap to show or hide; "Change order" opens the drag list.

**Send or save troubleshooting logs.** Settings > Troubleshooting can now email the recording to Continuo Labs support, or save it to a file (including Google Drive, if it is installed). On the master, the other tablet's recording is fetched and included too.

**A bigger, clearer piston stamp menu.** Every setting is a box you can tap, the memory level is shown up front, and picking a piston number closes the menu. Stops are tiles laid out like the console: reeds at the top, low stops along the bottom.

**Cleanup filters can be combined.** Tapping the cleanup button opens a list, so you can use Black and White and Darker together.

**Refresh an organ from the OHS Pipe Organ Database.** An organ you already have can pull its updated stop list without losing any registrations. Couplers are now included and can be recorded in a registration.

**Fixes:** a piston could repeat a general number when it rolled onto the next memory level; stops without a pitch could show the word "null"; and several small fixes to edit mode and the sidebar.

If you use two tablets together, update both.
